question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'A person who talks in sleep.'
solution: The correct answer is: **Somniloquist**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Somniloquist"** refers to a person who talks in their sleep. (नींद में बात करने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** As a somniloquist, John often mumbles random phrases while he sleeps, much to his roommate’s amusement. • **Explanation of the correct word:** The term "somniloquist" is derived from the Latin roots "somnus" meaning sleep and "loqui" meaning to speak. It specifically describes individuals who unconsciously talk while they are asleep. (नींद में बात करने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** The somniloquist startled his family when he began reciting poetry in his sleep. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Somniloquist**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Hypochondriac** (काल्पनिक रोगी): A person who is excessively worried about their health and often believes they are ill without real medical evidence. • **Example:** Being a hypochondriac, Sarah visits the doctor frequently for minor aches and pains. • **Somnambulist** (नींद में चलने वाला व्यक्ति): A person who walks in their sleep, also known as a sleepwalker. • **Example:** The somnambulist was found wandering the hallway in the middle of the night. • **Insomniac** (अनिद्रा पीड़ित): A person who suffers from insomnia, meaning they have difficulty falling or staying asleep. • **Example:** As an insomniac, she often spends hours reading books late at night. 49:T801, The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below
